## Activity

During October 2020, West Gate Eye Clinic completed 280 captures. This activity provides the basis for the site’s review of image quality and grading outcomes for the month. The reported capture total represents the imaging activity recorded by the clinic during the reporting period.

## Image quality

Of the 280 captures, 9 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 3.2. These images could not be used for grading, and the result is reported separately from the images that proceeded to assessment. Image quality should therefore be considered alongside the overall capture activity when reviewing the site’s monthly performance.

## Grading

The number of referable results was 54. The median grading lag was 1. Together, these measures summarise the grading workload and the time associated with processing results at West Gate Eye Clinic during October 2020. The figures provide a concise record of the site’s activity, image quality, and grading outcomes for the reporting period.
